registration-reservoir.text: Since this canyon is located below a reservoir that is occasionally drained, registration at {{REGISTRATION_PHONE}} is mandatory.

information-reservoir.text: Since this canyon is located below a reservoir that is occasionally drained, information can be found at {{CONTACT_INFORMATION}}.

awd-necessary.text: Since the drive from the lower parking area to all upper shuttle parking areas is on very steep gravel roads, a four-wheel-drive vehicle is required for the shuttle.

high-clearance-necessary.text: A high-clearance vehicle is required for access to the canyon, as the approach roads are uneven.

waves-at-exit.text: Since this canyon section ends directly at the sea, it is recommended to pay attention to tides and wave conditions.

boat-for-exit-necessary.text: Since this canyon section ends directly in the ocean, it is recommended to arrange a boat with local providers for the return transfer.

headlamps-necessary.text: Since this canyon section is partially in complete darkness, headlamps are absolutely necessary.

payment-to-enter.text: To enter this canyon, an entrance fee of {{AMOUNT_AND_CURRENCY}} per person must be paid.
